deviations: Plan M2 said a sub-architect's jj undo would be answered first by the architect's blanket bash gate. Under the architect-approved D1 option B the guard is judged from the pane's environment right after the debug log, ahead of the subagent exemption and therefore ahead of every role gate, and a sub-architect's pane classifies as phase-worker; so a sub-architect's jj undo now gets the shared-log reason (still refused). The role-matrix test's architect row expects that, with a comment; the root-architect test still expects the architect reason (its pane is not phase-worker).

The existing test 'blocks a bash call from a worker session that has not completed its boot handshake' set LEGION_TREE and LEGION_ROLE without LEGION_ISSUE; the hoisted classifySession call throws 'LEGION_ISSUE is required for Legion' for that env, exactly as session_start does. The fixture now carries the pane's full launch environment (LEGION_ISSUE added, one comment); its contract — block with 'Legion worker session is not registered' — is unchanged. Squashed into the step-1b commit.

The plan's step-5 eval row `"await Bun.$`jj op restore ${id}`"` trips biome's noTemplateCurlyInString (a warning; the pi-envoy job runs lint, and repo biome runs --error-on-warnings). Same runtime string written as a template literal with an escaped placeholder. Squashed into the step-5 commit.

Plan verification.repoCi named root `bunx tsc --noEmit` (no root tsconfig; tsc prints its help banner) and root `bun test` (sweeps every package; dispatch's React suites, claude-envoy-bridge, envoy-plugin, and daemon processes.test.ts fail from the root cwd — none touched here; processes.test.ts passes 252/0 from packages/daemon). The Tests workflow's lint/typecheck/test jobs actually run inside packages/daemon: `biome check --error-on-warnings src/` and `tsc --noEmit` there are clean. The root biome check the plan named was run and is clean.
trickyParts: Guard ordering: phaseWorkerPane ??= classifySession(process.env).kind === "phase-worker" is evaluated on the first tool_call of each module instance (a subagent has its own instance and inherits the pane env), then jjLogRewriteAttempt runs before checkSubagentSession. A malformed pane env throws from the hook exactly as session_start would; never computed at module load.

The bookmark legion/LEGION-45 auto-advances onto the working-copy commit in this provisioned workspace (which carries the untracked-on-main .omp/config.yml). Setting it to the described tip needs `jj bookmark set legion/LEGION-45 -r @- --allow-backwards`; the push is a plain fast-forward for origin.

The two post-hoc fixes were moved into their motivating commits with `jj squash --from @ --into <rev> <path>` one hunk at a time (temporarily restoring the other hunk in the working copy), so each commit on the branch stands on its own.

reviewRounds.rootCause: The bash matcher judged quoting and redirection metacharacters differently from bash, so argv-identical forms of the blocked commands were allowed (each proven to run in a scratch repo by the reviewer).
